// Package levelpractice 展示 LevelComponent 的正式实体/DAO/组件装配。
package levelpractice

import (
	"errors"
	"example.com/level-practice/dto"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/gameplay/level"
)

const RoomKind entity.EntityKind = 237
const LevelDaoCollection = level.CollectionName
const CompTypeLevel entity.ComponentType = 1

// 生成器按 NewLevelDao() 构造并设置 StorageID；选择瞬态或持久 DAO 是宿主职责。
type LevelDao struct{ *level.LevelDAO }

func NewLevelDao() *LevelDao { return &LevelDao{level.NewTransientLevelDAO(0)} }

func init() {
	entity.MustRegisterEntityKindCategory(RoomKind, entity.EntityCategoryWorld)
	entity.RegisterComponentFactory(CompTypeLevel, func(owner any, _ *entity.EntityCreateParam) (entity.ComponentInterfaceBase, error) {
		room := owner.(*Room)
		p, err := level.Compile(level.Definition{Version: 1, Name: "timed_room", Revision: 1, TimeDomain: "tick", Initial: []string{"play"}, Stages: []level.StageDefinition{{ID: "play", Triggers: []level.TriggerDefinition{
			{ID: "clock", Event: level.EventStageStart, Actions: []level.Action{{Kind: "timer", Name: "timeout", Delay: 10}}},
			{ID: "finish", Event: level.EventTimer, Actions: []level.Action{{Kind: "request", Name: "settle", LevelLifetime: true}, {Kind: "finish", Result: "timeout"}}},
		}}}}, level.Registry{Actions: map[string]level.ActionSpec{"settle": {Version: 1}}})
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return level.NewLevelComponent(room.state.LevelDAO, p)
	})
}

//roost:entity entityKind=RoomKind noPersist=true
type Room struct {
	*entity.EntityBase
	entity.ComponentManager
	entity.DaoManager
	state *LevelDao             `dao:"level_state"`
	flow  *level.LevelComponent `comp:"CompTypeLevel"`
}

//roost:nest target=RoomKind rollback=undo durability=memory
func Open(room *Room, instance string, epoch uint64) error {
	if err := room.flow.Initialize(instance, epoch, 0); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return room.flow.Start(0)
}

// Advance 只能由服务器模拟循环投递，tick 不是客户端自由填写的协议字段。
//
//roost:nest target=RoomKind rollback=undo durability=memory
func Advance(room *Room, tick uint64, fail bool) error {
	if err := room.flow.AdvanceTick(tick); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if fail {
		return errors.New("simulated handler failure")
	}
	return nil
}

//roost:nest target=RoomKind rollback=undo durability=memory
func Read(room *Room) (dto.ReadResult, error) {
	return dto.ReadResult{room.flow.Project(), room.flow.PendingActions()}, nil
}

//roost:nest target=RoomKind rollback=undo durability=memory
func Complete(room *Room, receipt level.Receipt, tick int64) error {
	return room.flow.Complete(receipt, tick)
}

//roost:nest target=RoomKind rollback=undo durability=memory
func Close(room *Room, tick int64) error { return room.flow.Close(tick) }
